pages.text: According to the supplied theory, a Draconium Core and supporting materials can form a framework that subjects items placed within it to Fusion. Draconium Blocks may even emerge with their properties strengthened.$(br2)Place the Crafting Core at the center, then place each Energy Injector three blocks away and facing inward. Nothing may obstruct the space between them; every channel must remain clear, including from other injectors.

pages.name: Simplest Basic Layout
pages.text: One working example, not a mandatory shape. Purple only marks the real Crafting Core—do not place glass. Each injector stands three blocks away and faces inward.
